title: Shape tweens
summary: Morph a square into a circle with a shape tween, play it, and steer the morph with shape hints.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.text:
In this lesson you will turn a square into a circle with a shape tween. A shape tween morphs one drawn shape into another: its outline, its position and its colors.

Phoenix has opened a new document for it. Click Next to begin.

steps.title: Pick the Rectangle tool
steps.text: Press R, or click the Rectangle tool in the toolbox. It shares a slot with the Oval: press and hold the slot to choose between them.

steps.title: Draw a square
steps.text:
Hold Shift and drag on the left of the stage to draw a square.

Shape tweens work on shapes, not on symbols or groups, so draw it straight onto the stage as it is.

steps.title: Go to frame 30
steps.text: In the timeline, click the cell under frame 30.

steps.title: Insert a blank keyframe
steps.text: Press F7, or choose Insert > Timeline > Blank Keyframe. The square holds up to frame 29, and frame 30 starts empty, ready for the shape it should become.

steps.title: Pick the Oval tool
steps.text: Press O, or hold the Rectangle's slot and choose the Oval tool. Pick another fill color too, if you like: colors tween along with the shape.

steps.title: Draw a circle
steps.text: Hold Shift and drag on the right of the stage to draw a circle.

steps.title: Make the shape tween
steps.text:
Right-click any frame between 1 and 29 and choose Shape Tween, or click one and choose Insert > Shape Tween.

The span turns green with an arrow.

steps.title: The Frame tab
steps.text: With a frame of the tween selected, the Properties panel's Frame tab shows Shape Tween in its Tween list. You can make or remove a tween from that list too, and set its Ease there.

steps.title: Play it
steps.text: Press Enter, or click the play button in the timeline header. The square slides across and rounds into a circle. Press it again to stop.

steps.title: Back to frame 1
steps.text: Stop playback and click frame 1. Shape hints, which steer a morph, go on the first keyframe of a shape tween.

steps.title: Add a shape hint
steps.text: Press Ctrl+Shift+H, or choose Modify > Shape > Add Shape Hint. A circle lettered a appears in the middle of the square.

steps.title: Pin it to a corner
steps.text: Press V for the Selection tool, then drag the hint onto the square's top-left corner. Hints on the first keyframe are yellow.

steps.title: Go to the end keyframe
steps.text: Click frame 30. The same hint waits there in the middle of the circle.

steps.title: Say where the corner goes
steps.text: Drag the hint onto the top of the circle's outline. The square's top-left corner will now travel to that point as it morphs.

steps.title: Play it again
steps.text: Press Enter and watch how the corner now sweeps to the top of the circle. Add more hints, up to 26, for more control; Modify > Shape > Remove All Hints clears them.

steps.title: Well done
steps.text:
You morphed a square into a circle with a shape tween and steered it with a shape hint.

Help > Tutorials has more lessons, such as Motion tweens and the Motion Editor and Masks.
